# Vendored dependencies

This directory is populated by `scripts/build_calibre_plugin.py`. It is not
committed because the vendored trees are bulky and kept in sync with each
build rather than hand-edited.

Expected contents after a build:

```
vendor/
├── ebooklib/     # copied from the installed ebooklib package (pure Python)
└── simplemma/    # copied from installed simplemma, pruned to the 9 core
                  # languages so the plugin zip stays small
```

Calibre's bundled Python already provides `lxml` and `beautifulsoup4`, so
those dependencies are not re-vendored.

`wordfreq` is intentionally *not* vendored. At runtime the plugin reads only
the precomputed `lemma_freq_*.json.gz` files shipped under `ell/data/`; the
surface-form frequency gate will be served from a second precomputed table
generated by the same build script (see the TODO in
`build_calibre_plugin.py`).
